findingDetails.title: Caller-supplied --prompt is rendered into report lines unsanitized
findingDetails.recommendation: Reject newlines and control characters in parsePrompt (usage error, exit 2) or render the prompt escaped so it cannot produce a report line.

findingDetails.title: Raw leg output is admitted into report lines without control-character filtering
findingDetails.recommendation: Strip ANSI/control characters from failLines output before rendering, or render the detail escaped.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: security review of a multi-leg execution script with a nine-case suite and a command contract; several producers feed one report rendering boundary

targetSelection.selectionReason: the iteration 1 handoff named the security focus: argv to displayed-command rendering, the read-only claim, and the leg-output trust boundary; the battery script is the execution surface and the doc pins how the prompt is sourced
omittedHighRiskTargets: pre-existing legs the battery spawns or requires (compiled-route-guard, drift guards, probe) - strategy non-goals
presentation contract and workflow YAML - not read this iteration

searchLedger.hypothesis: caller-controlled prompt or leg argv reaches a shell

searchActions.result: spawnSync argv arrays; no shell option; display strings never executed

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: full-file read shows argv-array spawns and no shell invocation anywhere
searchLedger.rationale: the only argv producer is parsePrompt, which returns one plain string passed as one argv element

searchLedger.hypothesis: caller-controlled prompt can forge report lines

searchActions.result: raw interpolation into the probe display and repairs; report prints verbatim

searchLedger.rationale: a prompt with a newline produces report-shaped lines; the rendering boundary has no escaping

searchLedger.hypothesis: raw leg output with control characters reaches the operator terminal

searchActions.result: prefix filter only, no sanitization before rendering

searchLedger.rationale: FAIL-prefixed lines pass through unfiltered into the report

searchLedger.hypothesis: SK_CODE_SETUP_ROOT redirects execution to an attacker-chosen tree

searchActions.result: documented fixture seam; the default root is the repository the battery already executes

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: env control of the invocation already implies equivalent capability; the seam adds no exposure beyond the default repo-execution design
searchLedger.rationale: the override is the documented test seam and the production caller does not set it

searchLedger.hypothesis: the bash leg resolved via PATH can be hijacked while node is pinned

searchActions.result: bash by name for one leg; node pinned via process.execPath elsewhere

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: PATH control already implies code-execution-equivalent capability; no elevation exists
searchLedger.rationale: hardening nicety only, not a finding

searchLedger.hypothesis: environment or secret values are read or printed

searchActions.result: no env reads beyond the root override; no secret-bearing output path

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: full read finds no secret access or secret-bearing output
searchLedger.rationale: children inherit the environment unchanged, standard for a repo-local doctor

searchLedger.hypothesis: a hung leg blocks the battery indefinitely
searchLedger.notApplicableReason: already registered as R1-P2-001 in the correctness iteration; re-reporting would double-count
searchLedger.rationale: security framing of the same defect adds no new information

searchLedger.hypothesis: child JSON strings become copy-pasteable repair commands

searchActions.result: entry.fix and root.name interpolated into displayed repairs

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: the legs already execute with the operator's privileges, so their output strings add no capability; the residual risk is a wrong command, covered as correctness in iteration 1
searchLedger.rationale: no escalation path beyond the trust already granted to the legs

searchLedger.invariant: the battery performs no filesystem writes on any path

searchActions.result: no fs module usage; only process.stdout/stderr writes; children invoked with check-only flags

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: no write path exists inside the battery; the residual assumption is the in-process guard require, a pre-existing non-goal leg
searchLedger.rationale: the read-only classification holds for the battery's own code
